_meta.description: Exchanges in the label files that have closed (defunct) or announced that they are closing (winding_down). An address an exchange used stays its address after it closes, so its labels are kept; but a letter addressed to a closed exchange as if it could answer wastes the officer's first, most urgent step. Read by app/exchange_status.py: every label of a listed exchange reads '(defunct)' or '(winding down)', and request_letters.py addresses a defunct exchange's letters to whoever now holds its records.
_meta.provenance: Each entry cites the public record it rests on. 'notice' is the exchange's own announcement, 'court' a court or regulator record, 'news' a report by a crypto news outlet, 'tracker' an exchange-listing site (weakest: two are cited where no notice or report was found). Checked by hand on 2026-11-15.
_meta.rule: An exchange is listed only if a cited source says it has stopped operating, or has announced a date when it will. Bilaxy (hacked in August 2021; reports say it resumed), ABCC (one listing site reports withdrawals suspended in October 2026) and Catex (no report found) are in the label files and not listed: no source was found that says they closed.

AscendEX.what: Ceased operations on 1 July 2026; withdrawals moved to manual review with no guarantee of payment.

Allbit.what: Website offline since 22 March 2021; listed as having ceased operations.

Bgogo.what: Stopped trading; website offline since 31 August 2021.

BitMart.what: Announced its wind-down on 26 July 2026: trading ended on 26 August 2026 and withdrawals close on 31 January 2027.

BitMEX.what: Ceased all exchange operations on 23 September 2026; its operator, HDR Global Trading Limited, keeps login and withdrawals open.

Bittrex.what: Bittrex (US) filed for Chapter 11 in May 2023; Bittrex Global ended all trading on 4 December 2023.

Celsius Network.what: Filed for Chapter 11 in the US Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York on 13 July 2022.

Cobinhood.what: Announced on 10 January 2020 that it was shutting down.

CoinEx.what: Announced its wind-down on 15 September 2026: spot trading ended on 29 September 2026 and the platform closes, with withdrawals, at 02:00 UTC on 22 December 2026.

Coinbene.what: Website offline since 15 November 2021; listed as permanently shut down.

FTX.what: FTX Trading Ltd. and its affiliates filed for Chapter 11 in the US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware on 11 November 2022 (case 22-11068).

Hotbit.what: Stopped all exchange operations at 04:00 UTC on 22 May 2023.

Kryptono.what: Website offline since 11 November 2021; listed as closed.

Liquid.what: Owned by FTX; suspended withdrawals on 15 November 2022 under FTX's Chapter 11 cases and then halted all trading.

TopBTC.what: Website offline since 1 May 2020; listed as inactive.

Yunbi.what: Closed all trading on 20 September 2017 under China's ban on exchange trading.
